verdict.rationale: PCI scope reduction is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions PCI compliance, certified or encrypting readers, end-to-end card data capture, or guidance on the merchant's remaining obligations. The receipt and offline-storage items are about other features and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations
